ctx.x: I didn't know that... They have a very good director.

Yes. And Dave Tough called me, I remember I was about 16 years old, and he called me up and he said are you familiar with the painter Cezanne and I said, I am sorry, I am not, I wasn't into painting at all. Well, he said, look the Louvre has rejected his works and the Chicago Art Institute bought them and let's go down tomorrow and have a look at this, and so we went down and I looked at this one beautiful thing, the first Cezanne I had ever seen and I said to Dave, 'I wish I could say something about this…
But Dave was the one who got into love for theatre, into books, into painting, into all the arts.
